caption:
Still carrying anger that won't cool? Kept wrath slowly becomes your cage. (Amos 1:11 devotional)

Anger nursed forever doesn't guard you — it hardens into a prison. You don't have to carry the sword to feel safe.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Whose name still stiffens my face — the wrath I've quietly kept ‘forever’?
